title.narrative: Community Education Program-Phase II: Social Equity Builders
Programa de Educacin Comunitaria-Fase II: Constructores de Equidad

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es mejorar los resultados de la educacin comunitaria atravs del mejoramiento del perfil, formacin y permanencia de las figuraseducativas del CONAFE. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) mejorar los procesosde captacin, formacin y desarrollo profesional de las figuras educativas deeducacin bsica; (ii) fortalecer los incentivos para la participacin y permanenciaen el servicio; (iii) incrementar la seguridad durante la prestacin del servicio; y(iv) fortalecer institucionalmente al CONAFE en sus sistemas de informacin,planificacin y seguimiento.

The objective of the program is to improve the results of community education by upgrading the profile, training, and retention rates of CONAFE educators. The specific objectives are: (i) to improve recruitment, education, and professional development of basic education teachers; (ii) to improve service participation and retention incentives; (iii) to improve personal safety during provision of service; and (iv) to provide for the institutional strengthening of CONAFE by improving its information, planning, and monitoring systems.
